reason: This passage (Exodus 32) depicts the Israelites having just abandoned Yahweh to worship a golden calf while Moses was receiving Torah on Mount Sinai. When Moses asks 'Who is for Yahweh?' only the Levites respond affirmatively, indicating that the people collectively had turned away from Yahweh worship. The text describes divine judgment being executed against those who rejected Yahweh, directly contradicting the claim that the Hebrews are 'first and foremost followers of Yahweh.' The passage explicitly demonstrates their capacity to reject Yahweh in favor of idolatry.
